summary:
Full court walkthrough verified on preview (align-report.preview.emergentagent.com). New test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter56_court_walkthrough.py drives the entire referral→accept→case→both parents→Legal Lens finalize→growth-met→Professional Statement ready→submit-to-court(include_legal_report=true)→judge court-view + PDFs. 7/7 backend tests pass. Public-frontend acceptance criteria verified via Playwright on /samples/legal-lens-report and /court/sample at desktop (1920) and mobile (390).

Backend verified:
1. Finalize without signature_name returns 400 ("Professional Signature Name is required to finalize").
2. submit-to-court with include_legal_report=true BEFORE Legal Lens is finalized returns 400 ("Finalize the Professional Evaluation Report before attaching it to a court submission") — separate fresh referral proved this.
3. After finalizing (ratings a=5, b=7, joint=6; three growth lines per parent) and marking the Professional Statement ready, submit-to-court with attest:true + include_legal_report:true returns 200 with submission.legal_report_included=true and legal_sha256 of length 64.
4. GET /api/court-dashboard/cases/{ref_id} exposes statement.legal_report_included=true, statement.legal_summary with scale_table (5 rows), placement={a:2, b:3, joint:2} matching the ratings, and growth.a with one line met=true.
5. GET /api/cases/{rid}/professional-report/pdf: text extracted via pypdf contains 'Individual Challenges & Growth', 'Joint Co-Parenting Dynamic' and 'growth areas met (' (percentage caption).
6. Public GET /api/joint/sample-legal-lens/pdf: text contains '1 of 3 growth areas met (33%)' and '2 of 3 growth areas met (67%)'.

Frontend verified (Playwright, no auth needed):
- /samples/legal-lens-report: vertical order lens-individual-scale-a (top=1969) → lens-individual-scale-b (2477) → lens-scale-table (2986); Parent B highlighted row contains 2 MET marks; mobile 390px: page scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no overflow) while each of the three .overflow-x-auto table wrappers has scrollWidth > clientWidth (451, 477, 459 vs 308) proving horizontal scroll works.
- /court/sample: court-legal-scale block contains all three tables (lens-individual-scale-a, lens-individual-scale-b, lens-scale-table); court-legal-growth-progress-a text = '1 of 3 growth areas met (33%)'; court-legal-growth-progress-b text = '2 of 3 growth areas met (67%)'; mobile 390px: no page overflow; three wrappers scroll horizontally (451, 477, 459 vs 258).

Authenticated /cases/{rid}/professional-report checkbox→progress-bar interaction and /court/case/{ref_id} judge private view were NOT re-driven through Playwright because the backend E2E test already exercises PUT growth_status (returning growth.a[0].met=true) and GET /court-dashboard/cases/{ref_id} (returning scale_table/placement/growth in the judge view). The public /court/sample page renders the same CourtLegalSummary component with identical testids, so the private judge view is structurally verified.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/court_workflow.py assert_submittable ordering: attest check happens after statement-ready check, so an unattested submit surfaces the correct 400 only when the statement is ready. This is fine but note that with attest=false + statement not ready, the caller receives the statement-ready error first (which is stricter feedback, so acceptable).

backend/court_workflow.py _legal_pdf_bytes silently flips a 'final' Legal Lens to 'submitted_to_court' inside submit-to-court but only when include_legal_report=true. That mutation is fine, however if the same case is re-submitted later without include_legal_report the report status stays 'submitted_to_court' from the earlier attachment — cosmetic (no functional bug) but consider naming that state more precisely so the professional editor doesn't show 'Submitted to Court' for a report that isn't attached to the newest packet.
backend/legal_lens.py court_summary always emits the full 5-row SCALE_TABLE even when ratings are null — good for the sample; the frontend correctly ignores placement rows when row=null.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of acceptance criteria for public sample pages + mobile overflow

test_credentials: casekit creates fresh t_iter56j_*@example.com judges and t_*@example.com pros/parents each run; conftest.py auto-purges @example.com fixtures after the session. Owner admin mattsossi@bsossi.com / CoParents2026! (preview) unused.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; all fixtures are ephemeral via casekit.new_user/complete_both and cleaned up by conftest._purge_fixture_accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter56_court_walkthrough.py -o addopts= -v (pytest.ini injects xdist -n auto which the fixture-scope=module dependency does not tolerate). BASE_URL must load /app/frontend/.env explicitly (load_dotenv is inside the test file). PDF text checks use pypdf 6.16.2 (already installed). For the private professional editor lens-growth-met-a-0 → lens-growth-progress-a UI check, seed via casekit and Playwright with page.on('dialog', d.accept()) since submit-to-court is gated by window.confirm.
